nodes.name: Lemma F.3
nodes.statement: Algorithm~alg:kapprox is a $1/k$-approximation algorithm for the {TMDS}\xspace problem.

nodes.name: Lemma F.4
nodes.statement: Algorithm~alg:batchpeel is a $\frac{1}{k(1+\xi)}$-approximation algorithm for the {TMDS}\xspace~problem.

nodes.name: Theorem 4.2
nodes.statement:
With probability at least $1-\eta$, \texttt{ProbPeel}\xspace achieves a 

$\frac{(1-\varepsilon)^2}{k(1+\xi)(1+\varepsilon)^2}$-approximation ratio for the {TMDS}\xspace~problem.

nodes.name: Theorem 4.3
nodes.statement:
With probability at least $1-\eta$, \texttt{HybridPeel}\xspace is a 
	$\frac{(1-\varepsilon)^2}{k(1+\xi)(1+\varepsilon)^2}$-approximation algorithm for the {TMDS}\xspace~problem when $J>1$,
	while for $J=1$ it achieves a $\frac{(1-\varepsilon)^2}{k(1+\xi)(1+\varepsilon)}$-approximation ratio.
